title: Impact of crystallography at Ni/NiAl interfaces on the nucleation of Ni3Al
notes: No intro/methods in packet: HYP/DES/PRC are text with requires_unseen. Two branches: (1) layer growth: EDX layers -> parabolic diagnostic -> diffusion control -> flux asymmetry + Kirkendall shift (joint) -> thicker/coarser Ni3Al on NiAl side; (2) nucleation: ORs of ~50% of new grains + bimodal, GB-switched grain density -> oriented nucleation; grain growth insensitive (F5b). Audits: o16 (48 h Ni3Al-into-(Ni) point below parabolic fit, text-silent), a2 (paper's own null result on crystallographic features vs nucleation class, in tension with F4 text), a3 (statistics mix Ni3Al and (Ni) grains), n24 (58 grains each side). Packet oddities: F5a counts 21 interfaces vs '20 configurations' in text; F5b uses two y-axes so 'no pronounced difference' is a scaled visual judgement; F3b green OR share looks smaller than the stated 41%; F4 and F5 linked text are partly duplicated.
